chunks: He shapes you in the womb of the mother as He wills. There is no god but He, the all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how God creates humans in the womb?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of divine creative will (Irada) and the unique formation of the Imams, who are seen as the perfect manifestations of God's wisdom in creation. The phrase 'in whatever manner He chooses' underscores God's absolute freedom from external constraints, a key theological point in Usuli scholarship regarding divine omnipotence. This affirmation of monotheism serves as a bridge between the physical act of creation and the spiritual reality of divine guidance.
